cover_headline: India's Top Six IT Firms Shed 24,422 Engineering Roles in One Year
facts: Combined headcount fell 24,422 in a year, from 822,144 in October 2025 to 797,722 in October 2026
About 92,000 people left and about 68,000 were hired, with exits beating hiring in five of the last six months
Hiring has slowed most for 5-12 year roles in manual testing, maintenance and L1/L2 support, while AI, cloud and cybersecurity demand keeps growing

end.headline: India's Top Six IT Firms Shed 24,422 Engineering Roles in One Year
end.line: Exits of about 92,000 outpaced hiring of 68,000 at TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, Tech Mahindra and LTIMindtree, Xpheno data show, as firms left vacant seats unfilled.

quote.text: Annual attrition has remained at 11-15%, but companies haven't necessarily refilled attrited seats.
quote.speaker: Francis Padamadan
